name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Only calls the same unnamed routine twice before decoding reaches invalid instruction bytes, so the body is a stub and no further behaviour can be recovered.

name: store_pointer_pair_and_call
description: Loads a value through the pointer held in A6, saves it to one RAM cell, then saves that value plus 13000 to a second cell before calling an unnamed routine.

name: save_pair_and_dispatch_entry
description: Saves the value behind the A6 pointer and the A0 register into two RAM cells, then calls a routine whose address is read from a table indexed by D0 times eight.

name: program_cia_b_timer
description: Writes a control value, an interrupt mask and the high and low count bytes of the CIA B timer, which arms that timer with a fixed count.

name: split_run_at_block_boundary
description: Divides an input count by 6200 to get a block index and remainder, then runs unnamed transfer routines over the portion before and after each block boundary.

name: call_routine_return_zero
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns zero. It is a thin forwarding wrapper with no other visible effect.

name: call_routine_return_zero
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns zero. It is a thin forwarding wrapper with no other visible effect.

name: copy_bytes_from_source_offset
description: Copies a run of bytes from a source buffer, starting at an offset kept in a structure, to the destination pointer, then stores the advanced destination pointer back in the structure.

name: increment_counter_then_run_setup
description: Increments a counter, calls two unnamed routines, then merges pairs of 32-bit words into bit-interleaved output for 1550 entries. It then enters an endless setup loop that clears memory blocks, waits on a status flag and calls numbered unnamed routines.

name: select_parity_and_drain
description: Reads a 16-bit value from an unnamed routine, choosing the call by the low bit of D0, and compares it shifted right by one with a stored word. If they differ, it calls another routine until that returns zero.

name: drain_until_counter_matches
description: Reads a word from an unnamed routine and compares it, shifted right by one, with a stored word. If they differ, it calls another routine until that returns zero.

name: drain_until_zero_return
description: Calls an unnamed routine repeatedly until it returns zero, then returns.

name: read_disk_track_and_verify
description: Programs the disk controller and DMA for a read using the standard disk sync word, waits for the transfer to finish, then sums a block of 32-bit words and repeats until the sum matches the stored checksum.

name: decrement_count_and_restart_timer
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter, updates two bits of a control byte, then reprograms the CIA B timer registers the same way as the timer setup routine.

name: increment_count_and_restart_timer
description: Increments a 16-bit counter, updates bits of a control byte, then reprograms the CIA B timer registers the same way as the timer setup routine.

name: wait_until_status_bit_clears
description: Spins until bit 5 of the byte addressed by A2 is clear, then returns.

name: clear_flag_and_wait_status
description: Clears bit 2 of the byte addressed by A1, then waits until bit 5 of the byte addressed by A2 is clear.

name: set_flag_and_wait_status
description: Sets bit 2 of the byte addressed by A1, then waits until bit 5 of the byte addressed by A2 is clear.

name: run_setup_after_bitplane_merge
description: Merges pairs of 32-bit words into bit-interleaved output for 1550 entries, skipping a two-byte marker if present. It then enters an endless setup loop that clears memory blocks, waits on a status flag and calls numbered unnamed routines.

name: update_byte_index_from_table
description: Stores a word into a buffer field, calls an unnamed routine, then advances a byte index using a lookup in a table. Decoding ends in bad instruction data, so the tail of the routine is unreliable.

name: configure_display_dma_and_interrupts
description: Writes to display, DMA and interrupt-enable registers, with bit 15 of each write selecting set or clear. The decompiler timed out, so the exact sequence and its values are not recovered.

name: empty_return_stub
description: Does nothing and returns; the executable has a single instruction here, so it is a stub with no behaviour.

name: call_two_unnamed_routines
description: Calls two unnamed routines and nothing else is visible. The decompiler timed out, so the body is not recovered beyond the facts.

name: call_library_patch_on_failure
description: Calls a library function through a table entry, storing the result pointer and reference in RAM cells. When the call returns a negative result it writes absolute jump, subroutine call and no-op opcodes into code, then loops forever; the referenced text is the word disk.

name: patch_code_locations_with_opcodes
description: Overwrites many code locations with no-op, branch and return opcodes, calls three unnamed routines in the middle of the sequence, then writes two values including one to the interrupt enable register.

name: copy_global_into_cell
description: Copies a shared global value into another RAM cell and returns. Its meaning depends on the unnamed callers.

name: empty_return_stub
description: Returns immediately with no body in the pseudo-code. The disassembly reports 12 instructions, so the routine is at most a stub with no recoverable behaviour.

name: adjust_byte_unless_letter_f
description: Subtracts two from the byte addressed by A0 unless that byte is the letter f, then adds one to it.

name: advance_state_and_dispatch_handler
description: Advances a counter capped at 14, records the previous state and, when the state changes, calls a handler through a table entry. It branches on a four-character signature, and at the end writes constants to global cells.

name: advance_state_and_dispatch_handler
description: Advances a counter capped at 14, records the previous state and, when the state changes, calls a handler through a table entry. It branches on a four-character signature, and at the end writes constants to global cells.

name: advance_state_and_dispatch_irq
description: Runs the same state advance and handler dispatch as its neighbours, with 13 further unnamed calls. The facts also list the interrupt enable and request registers as touched.

name: run_once_when_marker_matches
description: When a marker byte equals the letter M and a flag is still zero, calls an unnamed routine and sets the flag. While the flag is one, it calls another unnamed routine on every run.

name: run_once_when_marker_matches
description: When a marker byte equals the letter M and a flag is still zero, calls an unnamed routine and sets the flag. While the flag is one, it calls another unnamed routine on every run.

name: write_padded_text_message
description: Fills a 22-longword buffer with a text string by storing four-character groups at fixed offsets, padding the gaps with spaces. The characters are fixed in the stores themselves.

name: store_cells_and_patch_opcodes
description: Stores its argument and two pointer values into RAM cells, calls an unnamed routine, then compares a cell against a fixed address and overwrites words with no-op opcodes on a match. It returns a sum of cells.

name: wait_until_raster_result_zero
description: Repeatedly calls the raster-line wait routine until the word returned in D1 is zero, which waits for the display beam to reach the target line.

name: return_masked_cell_value
description: Returns the value of a RAM cell masked to its low 48 bits and does not write anything.

name: call_library_entry_passthrough
description: Calls a function through a fixed slot of a library table and passes its results straight back to the caller.

name: call_library_entry_passthrough

name: call_library_entry_passthrough
description: Calls a function through a fixed slot of a library table and passes its results straight back to the caller.

name: call_library_slot_save_text
description: Calls a function through a library table slot and passes its results back. The routine references the text ElfMania.save.

name: call_alt_library_slot_save
description: Calls a function through a different library table slot and passes its results back. The routine references the same save text.

name: disable_all_dma_and_interrupts
description: Writes the all-bits-clear value, with bit 15 clear, to the interrupt, DMA and interrupt request registers, then calls one unnamed routine.

name: set_background_color_value
description: Writes the value 240 to the background colour register and returns.

name: decode_bitstream_into_buffer
description: Reads bits from a packed input stream, refilling it in 16-bit words, and decodes codes through lookup tables for values and lengths. Decoded bytes are written backward from the end of an output buffer.

name: write_branch_and_jump_patches
description: Writes branch, no-op followed by absolute jump, and subroutine-call opcodes at fixed offsets from the base pointer, then returns zero.

name: store_constant_block_and_flag
description: Sets a flag word to 1 and writes four fixed longwords into a buffer, the first of which is zero.

name: patch_jsr_and_call_target
description: Writes a subroutine-call opcode and an absolute address into a code location, then calls through an indirect jump that the decompiler could not resolve.

name: write_words_and_call_pointer
description: Loads a routine pointer from a fixed offset of the base, writes two instruction words into it, then calls that pointer. The indirect target is not recovered.

name: drive_disk_read_retry_loop
description: Runs a disk read loop that sets and clears status bits and calls an unnamed disk routine, retrying on failure. On success it dispatches through a computed jump, and it writes the CIA B port register and the DMA and interrupt enable registers.

name: poll_disk_status_and_retry
description: Clears a status bit, sets two others and repeatedly calls an unnamed routine until a status word reports completion, retrying when the result is negative. It returns through a computed jump on success.

name: select_pattern_and_wait_status
description: Selects one of three constant patterns from status bits, then waits for a status bit to clear and steps a counter down from 20 until it reaches zero.

name: set_flag_pattern_when_clear
description: When the high bits of a status byte are clear and bits 0 and 3 are clear, sets bit 3 and writes a fixed pattern into a shared cell. Returns a value derived from the high bits.

name: dispatch_status_change_handler
description: Reads a cell and updates a rolling byte counter. When the status byte changes, it calls a handler through a computed jump if the high bit or bit 1 requests it.

name: swap_buffers_by_status_bit
description: Swaps 16500 longwords between a buffer and a second buffer offset by 1000 bytes. The buffer pair is chosen by bit 0 of a status word.

name: wait_and_clear_pending_word
description: Waits for a flag to clear, then if a counter word is non-negative it zeroes a word and waits until a second word reads zero before setting the counter to minus one.

name: install_interrupt_vector_and_enable
description: Stores a routine address in a vector cell, writes a disabling value and then an enabling value to the interrupt control registers, and clears a state cell.

name: call_pointer_then_clear_request
description: Calls a stored routine pointer, calls it again when a second pointer is non-null, then writes a bit 5 value to the interrupt request register and calls one unnamed routine.

name: copy_block_and_relocate_pointers
description: Copies a block of longwords into the start of a buffer, with the count taken from the block header, then adds the buffer base address to each entry of a second table as a relocation pass.

name: copy_longwords_then_spin
description: Copies 120 longwords from one address to another, calls one unnamed routine, then loops forever.

name: call_stack_address_then_spin
description: Computes two address values from a stack argument by fixed offsets, stores them in global cells, calls the routine at the argument address, then loops forever.

name: load_segments_then_jump
description: Copies a block of longwords from a source and relocates its pointer entries, then writes transfer parameter values for each entry of a table. It copies 3750 longwords from a fixed source into low memory, then jumps to a fixed entry address.

name: spin_forever_stub
description: Loops forever with no other work in the pseudo-code, so it acts as a halt loop.

name: setup_disk_transfer_copy
description: Sets a status bit, writes transfer and interrupt values, copies 3750 longwords into low memory, calls two unnamed routines, then jumps to a fixed entry address. The facts list the disk length register and the interrupt enable register as touched.

name: add_value_to_offset_entries
description: Adds a value to each longword addressed by a table of offsets relative to a base, stepping through the table until its counter wraps.

name: call_stack_address_then_spin
description: Computes two address values from a stack argument by fixed offsets, stores them in global cells, calls the routine at the argument address, then loops forever.

name: init_slot_or_dispatch_state
description: If a state word is nonzero, calls a routine through an offset table. Otherwise, when bit 0 is clear, it stores initial values into slot cells, then computes an inverted low nibble from the status and sets a flag bit when that nibble is zero.

name: save_status_and_select_state
description: Saves the current status word into cells, clears the low nibble and several slot cells, and calls an unnamed routine when the high bit is set. It then sets a state value of two or three from flag bits, and copies a saved value back when a flag is set.

name: select_state_from_flags
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then sets the state to two when bit 1 is set or to three when bit 2 is set. Otherwise, when bit 0 is set and the state is zero, it restores a saved value and clears bit 2.

name: save_status_and_restore_flags
description: Saves the status word into cells, calls an unnamed routine, then sets the state from status bits. It restores a saved value and clears flags when bit 0 is set and the state is zero.

name: save_status_and_restore_flags
description: Saves the status word into cells, calls an unnamed routine, then sets the state from status bits. It restores a saved value and clears flags when bit 0 is set and the state is zero.

name: record_slot_bit_copy_entry
description: Sets a bit in a slot mask selected by a counter, stores a word into that slot, then copies four longwords from the argument into the slot's table and returns one.

name: select_highest_priority_slot_entry
description: Scans four 16-word slots for the nonzero entry with the highest priority value whose flag byte is zero. If none is found it sets the state to four; otherwise it copies fields from that entry into a record and sets a state from status bits.

name: set_state_four_stub
description: Sets the global state value to four and returns.

name: set_flag_store_handler
description: Sets bit 2 of the status cell, stores a routine address in a handler cell, then copies the saved status value back into the status cell.

name: configure_disk_sync_and_dma
description: Writes DMA and ADKCON control values, the standard disk sync word and CIA B port values. It then calls a stored handler when one is set, or otherwise runs the stored setup routines.

name: tick_slot_countdown_and_arm
description: Decrements a countdown in a slot record and sets a completion bit when it reaches zero, then increments a tick counter. When the slot sub-count is zero it resets fields, sets mask bits, calls two unnamed routines and stores a handler pointer.

name: reset_slot_when_countdown_ends
description: Decrements a countdown in a slot record. When it reaches zero, it resets the record, sets mask bits, calls two unnamed routines and stores a handler pointer.

name: shift_out_bits_to_port
description: Writes a sequence of 32 data bits to a byte-wide port, building a shift value. It then sets or clears a slot mask bit depending on whether the value is all ones and calls unnamed routines to arm a handler.

name: arm_slot_handler_if_idle
description: If a slot countdown field is nonzero, stores a handler pointer and returns. Otherwise it sets a mask bit, calls an unnamed routine and stores the handler pointer, copying the previous handler when the flag bit was already set.

name: start_slot_timer_on_flag
description: Sets a flag bit and, when it was already set, resets the slot counter to 50 and clears its field, writes values to the chip registers, then stores a handler pointer. Otherwise it only stores handler pointers.

name: store_handler_pointer
description: Stores a routine address into the first cell of the slot record and returns.

name: copy_saved_value_into_slot

name: clear_slot_record_fields

name: call_table_spin_on_flags

name: call_between_interrupt_control_writes

name: select_mode_by_magic_match
description: Sets a mode cell to three when a register holds a fixed magic value and to four otherwise, then calls one unnamed routine through a table slot.

name: set_bit_copy_then_halt

name: repeat_call_then_slot_call

name: store_argument_and_set_limit
description: Stores the argument into one global cell and sets a second cell to 524288.

name: add_to_cell_call_slot
description: Adds the D7 register value to a global cell, calls an unnamed routine through a table slot, and returns the cell's previous value.

name: copy_byte_run_to_pointer

name: repeat_call_then_slot_call

name: wait_slot_and_dispatch
description: Waits until a counter reaches a limit and a status flag is clear, marks the slot pending and copies a value into a register-backed cell. It then calls a routine through a computed table entry, and clears a field first when the slot's flag is zero.

name: decrement_counter_then_wait_dispatch
description: Decrements a countdown and clears a field when it reaches zero, then waits for a counter to reach a limit and a status flag to clear. It marks the slot pending and calls a routine through a computed table entry.

name: swap_slot_buffer_pointers

name: clear_counter_wait_for_signal

name: build_copper_list_into_buffer

name: call_routine_power_of_two
description: Calls an unnamed routine a number of times equal to two raised to a slot field value, counting down to zero, then returns.

name: load_descriptor_into_slot_record

name: load_slot_fields_call_three
description: Copies a field and a control word derived from the descriptor into a slot record, then calls three unnamed routines.

name: set_field_two_and_call

name: set_state_from_descriptor_sign

name: copy_word_into_slot_field
description: Copies the word addressed by the pointer into a slot field and returns.

name: copy_word_set_state_six

name: copy_three_words_into_slot
description: Copies three words from the pointer into fixed slot fields and clears another field.

name: dispatch_slot_handler_by_index
description: Looks up a routine address through a table indexed by a slot field and calls it through an indirect jump that the decompiler could not resolve.

name: store_word_at_indexed_offset
description: Looks up an offset from a table indexed by the first word addressed by the pointer, then stores the second word at that offset in the slot record.

name: copy_table_fields_into_slot
description: Copies four words from a table entry into fixed slot fields, stores an address computed from the second longword, and sets a field to two.

name: set_field_to_twenty

name: scale_packed_nibbles_by_factor

name: copy_longwords_by_slot_count
description: Copies a count of longwords from one buffer to another, with the buffers and count taken from fields of the slot record.

name: advance_slot_counter_and_call

name: decode_rle_with_row_stride

name: decode_packed_runs_into_buffer

name: verify_checksum_then_proceed

name: set_state_four_stub
description: Sets the state field to four and returns.

name: xor_fold_longwords_masked
description: Folds a run of longwords starting at the pointer into one value by exclusive-or, then returns it masked by a register value.

name: combine_masked_longword_pair
description: Returns a value built from the two longwords addressed by the pointer, each masked by a register value, with the first shifted left by one bit.

name: build_pointer_pair_record
description: Computes two pointer values from an offset and a stored cursor, stores them with a constant word pair and a field in a record, and advances the cursor. It also sets a field to eight times the offset plus two.

name: initialise_slot_registers_and_tables
description: Stores a magic longword and pointer values in a slot record, writes all-clear masks to three chip register offsets and clears control words. It sets configuration fields, stores routine addresses in a table and then calls several unnamed routines.

name: decode_direction_bits_to_steps
description: Decodes direction bits from a register value into two signed step values, one per axis, using exclusive-or of paired bits.

name: update_clamped_position_from_deltas
description: Updates two position values by the differences between two input bytes and stored bytes, wrapping each difference. It then clamps the first position to 0 through 311 and the second to 0 through 98.

name: dispatch_input_event_by_table
description: When a status word has bit 14 set, it examines masked input bits. When bit 4 is clear it marks a flag, increments a counter and calls a routine through a computed table entry; otherwise it clears a flag and sets a control word.

name: setup_bits_advance_sequence
description: Sets and clears bit flags in several cells and a register-backed byte, then writes a value to a chip register. It advances a counted sequence stored in the record and calls routines when a step completes.

name: advance_sequence_step_and_call
description: Sets a state field to eight, calls three unnamed routines and writes a value to a chip register. It advances a counted sequence and calls a routine when a step completes.

name: scan_port_columns_and_advance
description: Writes six byte patterns to an input port, then sets a flag and state fields, calls three unnamed routines and advances a counted sequence.

name: clear_bit_write_port_pair
description: Clears bit 1 of a control byte, writes two values to port-like offsets and clears a third byte.

name: read_keyboard_handshake_store
description: When two status bits are set, inverts a serial data byte and performs a handshake through the CIA A serial data and control registers, waiting for the handshake to clear. It then stores a decoded key flag and a word in the record and sets a control word to eight.

name: wait_until_raster_result_zero
description: Repeatedly calls an unnamed routine until the word returned in D1 is zero, which waits for a hardware result to clear.

name: shift_state_longword_with_feedback
description: Shifts a 32-bit state longword left by one, adding one depending on two bit tests, then stores the result back.

name: select_channel_by_input_bits
description: Selects one of four records from input bits and sets a matching control word. When the selected record's counter is zero it resets its fields and loads a pointer, otherwise it decrements the counter.

name: write_pending_word_to_chips
description: When a pending word is nonzero, writes it with bit 15 set to one chip register and writes it shifted left by seven to another, then clears the pending word. It then calls four unnamed routines.

name: update_clamped_counter_record
description: Adds a step to a counter in a record and clamps it between zero and 256, writing a scaled value to a second cell and resetting when it goes negative. It then adds a second step to another field and stores it.

name: initialise_four_slot_records
description: Stores a pointer and fixed word values into four records, calling an unnamed routine to supply each pointer. It then clears two flag bytes.

name: clear_record_counter_fields
description: Clears two word fields and two byte fields of the record addressed by A0.
